headline: Rheinmetall Shares Plunge 17% on Profit Warning Over Order Delays
summary: German defense giant Rheinmetall saw its shares drop more than 17% after warning of delays to military contracts and ammunition approvals.
why: Rheinmetall is a major European defense contractor whose financial performance heavily influences the European aerospace and defense sector.

impacts.name: Rheinmetall AG
impacts.why: The profit warning and order delays directly caused a sharp decline in the company's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company issued a profit warning due to unexpected delays in military contracts and ammunition approvals.
